name: Original Mojo Verde from Tenerife

recipeInstructions.text: In a food processor or blender, add the fresh cilantro and parsley leaves. Make sure to remove any tough stems.
recipeInstructions.name: Prepare the herbs

recipeInstructions.text: Add the peeled garlic cloves, cumin seeds, sea salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes to the food processor.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the garlic and spices

recipeInstructions.text: Pulse the mixture until the herbs and garlic are finely chopped.
recipeInstructions.name: Blend the mixture

recipeInstructions.text: While the processor is running, slowly drizzle in the olive oil until the mixture is well combined and a smooth paste forms.
recipeInstructions.name: Incorporate olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Add the white wine vinegar and fresh lemon juice. Blend again until all ingredients are fully integrated.
recipeInstructions.name: Mix in the vinegar and lemon juice

recipeInstructions.text: Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if necessary by adding more salt or lemon juice to your liking.
recipeInstructions.name: Adjust seasoning

recipeInstructions.text: Transfer the mojo verde to a small bowl or jar. It can be served immediately, but for better flavor, let it sit for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator before serving.
recipeInstructions.name: Serve

description: A fresh, zesty green sauce from the Canary Islands, perfect for drizzling over grilled meats and vegetables.
